scenarios.label: Public app for many Gusto customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your AI agent connects Gusto accounts of customers outside your company, which is the normal production case.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count and the security documents required, not measured

scenarios.approval: Production Pre-Approval by the Partnerships team, then a Security Review by the GRC team. Gusto also assigns your API scopes during review.

prerequisites.title: Security documentation ready
prerequisites.detail: Prepare audits such as SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 with SOA or PCI DSS, plus penetration test reports, policies, and security and incident response contacts. Without a formal audit, you must describe controls such as MFA, encryption and vulnerability scanning.

prerequisites.title: Eligibility as a Gusto partner
prerequisites.detail: Gusto limits API access to App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners and does not support early-stage products without a track record serving small businesses.

steps.title: Create Gusto developer application
steps.detail: Register your application in the Gusto Developer Portal to get sandbox client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You have sandbox client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom Gusto auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and register it in your Gusto application.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and the redirect URI is registered with Gusto.

steps.title: Test scopes in demo environment
steps.detail: Test the scopes needed for your use case in Gusto's demo environment. Request only the bare minimum of scopes.
steps.done_when: Your integration works in demo with the minimum scopes.

steps.title: Draft security review materials
steps.detail: Draft policy summaries and control descriptions from your own documents, and list the contacts needed.
steps.done_when: A complete document package is ready for your review.

steps.title: File Production Pre-Approval
steps.detail: Submit the application with business details and security documentation. Then take no further action until Gusto replies.

steps.title: Wait for approval and security review
steps.detail: Partnerships reviews first, then the GRC team starts the Security Review. Reply quickly to any information request, because the review is on hold until you do.
steps.done_when: Gusto emails next steps and production setup begins.

traps.title: Security Review pauses on missing information
traps.detail: Gusto may request more information beyond your application, and the review is put on hold until you respond. Watch the inbox for such requests.

traps.title: Production rejects out-of-scope calls
traps.detail: Scopes are assigned by Gusto during review and enforced in production, so calls outside them fail. Changes after launch need an email request to Gusto.

traps.title: Access tokens last only 2 hours
traps.detail: Plan token refresh from the start, since access tokens expire 2 hours after issue.

traps.title: One authorization per company
traps.detail: Since API version v2023-05-01, a token covers one company only, so multi-company admins must authorize each company separately.

traps.title: Composio consent screen shows Composio
traps.detail: Without your own app, users see 'Composio wants to access your account'. For Gusto you must use your own app anyway.

blockers.symptom: No production keys; only sandbox keys available
blockers.what_it_means: Gusto issues production keys only after Production Pre-Approval and Security Review are approved.
blockers.what_to_do: File Production Pre-Approval and complete the Security Review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the security documentation and control descriptions for your review.

blockers.symptom: Application is not accepted as a partner
blockers.what_it_means: Gusto restricts API access to partners and does not support early-stage products without a track record.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact Gusto's partnerships team to confirm eligibility before investing in the build.

open_questions: How long do Production Pre-Approval and Security Review take? Ask Gusto's partnerships team or check the application confirmation.
Is there a minimum customer count or track record needed? Ask Gusto's partnerships team; no number was found.
